findings.body: The fallback checks whether the story document exists, rather than whether the story branch exists. If an existing story branch deletes or moves its approved document, this reads the older document and approval from the default branch instead. With no story worktree present and the task checkout still holding that older document, all checks pass and work continues under the old approval. `task.show` returns None for a missing path (src/forge/task.py:94–97). Fall back only when the story branch is absent; a missing document on an existing branch must refuse before the status commit.
